title: Top Account Priority Sensitivity Index and Negotiated Fallbacks
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a reproducible, customer-driven priority index for top accounts that surfaces sensitivity to delivery delay and defines negotiable fallback commitments. The index will combine quantitative signals (ARR, monthly usage, incident frequency, feature dependency score) with qualitative signals (executive advocacy, strategic alignment, regulatory risk) to provide a single sensitivity score. Deliverables: 1) scoring model and schema, 2) intake UI fields and lightweight API for score calculation, 3) standard negotiation fallback playbook (what we commit vs what can be deferred), 4) tooling to show trade-offs on the roadmap and an audit log for customer communications.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring model documented with weight rationale and at least four example customer scores
Intake form updated in Console prototype and API endpoint calculated score returns consistent values
Fallback playbook published with 3 template negotiation letters and escalation paths
Roadmap view shows sensitivity score and suggested mitigation (canary, SLA credit, alternate model) and preserves audit trail
